risks.risk: The specific Nikon model is unknown, which determines the entire price bracket.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name on the camera body (e.g., D3500, D850).

risks.risk: Internal optical damage such as fungus or deep scratches.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear glass elements of both lenses.
risks.if_unproven: As requiring professional cleaning or having degraded image quality.

risks.risk: High shutter count indicating the camera is near the end of its mechanical life.
risks.proof: A screenshot from a shutter count checking tool using the last photo taken.
risks.if_unproven: As a high-mileage unit near mechanical failure.

risks.risk: Electronic failure or sensor defects (dead pixels/scratches).
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, focusing, and taking a clear photo.

proof_requests: Photo of the camera model name on the front or top of the body.
Photos of the lens barrels showing the focal length and aperture markings.
Close-up photos of the lens glass (front and back) and the camera sensor.
A photo of the battery and charger.
A video of the camera turning on and the LCD screen working.
response.reason: The specific Nikon model was not identified by the witness. Without knowing the model, it is impossible to provide even a worst-case valuation as the price range for Nikon DSLRs is extremely broad.
